name: Heating and air conditioning
summary: Furnace and A/C repair and replacement, plus A/C covers and roof covers to protect them.
bring: The keys to the unit and any compartment locks
What the furnace or A/C is doing (no heat, no cold air, a noise, a fault light)

faq.q: The furnace fan runs but there’s no heat. What’s wrong?
faq.a: Usually it’s the ignition, the propane supply or a sensor. We test each one, find the fault and quote the repair.

faq.q: Is it worth repairing an old A/C unit?
faq.a: Sometimes. Once we’ve found the fault we tell you what a repair costs and what a replacement costs, so you can choose.
It depends on the unit and the fault, so we quote after we’ve inspected it.
